Control_Objective: Approved security policies define responsibilities and review dates
Pass_Criteria: Approved policy set, named owners, annual review, exceptions tracked
Condition_Summary: No approved corporate security policy documents or formal review history were available for inspection.

Operating_Rating: All 18 assets have unique IDs, owners, classification, criticality, and status
GDPR_Relevance: 18 of 18 assets contained required fields; no duplicate IDs were identified.

Design_Rating: Method exists, scores recalculate, High and Critical risks have owners and dates
CIS_Control: Risk records were internally consistent (R-003 inherent 4x5=20; R-005 residual 3x5=15), but formal approval and recurring executive review evidence were not available.

Control_Objective: MFA is enforced for all workforce and privileged identities
Pass_Criteria: 100% active workforce identities covered and legacy authentication blocked
Condition_Summary: MFA is active for only 4 administrator accounts out of 60 workforce identities resulting in a 6.7% coverage rate and a 93.3 percentage-point gap.

Control_Objective: Access rights are reviewed and inappropriate access is removed
Pass_Criteria: Quarterly review covers active, privileged, dormant, and departed accounts, with exceptions closed
Condition_Summary: No records of regular access entitlement reviews or account lifecycle checklists were available.

Control_Objective: Critical vulnerabilities and patches are managed within defined targets
Pass_Criteria: Approved severity targets, current status, exceptions, and evidence of timely remediation
Condition_Summary: Patch execution relies on informal administrator notes rather than automated validation with no approved SLAs or vulnerability tracking reports.

Control_Objective: Secure configurations are defined and checked for Windows and Ubuntu
Pass_Criteria: Approved baselines, deployment evidence, deviation record, and periodic validation
Condition_Summary: No documented configuration hardening benchmarks or automated baseline checking records were found.

Design_Rating: CloudTrail enabled, priority events defined, review frequency assigned, sample review completed
CIS_Control: Log generation is designed and CloudTrail is enabled via the cloud environment
GDPR_Relevance: but active review pipelines and escalation workflows are not operationally evidenced.

Design_Rating: Approved plan, roles, severities, communications, annual exercise, action tracking
CIS_Control: An unapproved draft incident response document exists
GDPR_Relevance: but no live scenario testing or exercise logs have been recorded in the past 12 months.

Control_Objective: Backups are protected and recoverability is tested
Pass_Criteria: Backup success plus quarterly restore, integrity check, recovery time, and issue tracking
Condition_Summary: Automated data storage back-up routines are partially evidenced as operational
NIST_CSF: but restoration testing is ineffective due to a complete absence of integrity validation or recovery time metrics (supporting R-005).

Control_Objective: Personal and sensitive data is classified
Operating_Rating: Inventory, purpose, access, retention, deletion, and owner are documented and reviewed
GDPR_Relevance: Data classification schemes are defined inside the asset inventory register
Related_Risks: but underlying data retention periods have not been formally validated with legal or business owners.

Control_Objective: Vendors receive risk-based due diligence and required contract terms
Pass_Criteria: Critical vendors prioritized, evidence reviewed, processor terms checked, decision approved
Condition_Summary: Commercial supplier agreements are assumed to exist
NIST_CSF: but structured third-party security due diligence workflows are entirely absent.

Control_Objective: Vendor security and service risk is monitored through the relationship
Pass_Criteria: Owners, review frequency, incidents, assurance changes, exceptions, and termination actions tracked
Condition_Summary: No programmatic verification procedures or continuous tracking logs exist to monitor vendor compliance over time.

Operating_Rating: Approved storage, secret scanning, rotation, ownership, and response process evidenced
GDPR_Relevance: Relying on private repositories alone does not prove active monitoring controls; no automated pipeline credential scanning is currently operational.

Control_Objective: Personnel receive role-relevant security awareness and follow-up
Pass_Criteria: Annual assignment, completion, role-specific content, overdue follow-up, and effectiveness review
Condition_Summary: No training metrics or awareness course completion logs were provided; no objective conclusion can be supported for this evaluation window.
